answer: Make sybil clusters pay quadratically. Accounts driven by one operator tend to share a stylistic kernel: the same phrasing habits, timing and mistakes. If each epoch the network maps near-duplicate work into an atlas of clusters and slashes every bonded member by a fraction scaled to cluster size squared, ten fake accounts lose a hundredfold while a lone honest agent loses nothing. The bond is the harbor fee a sybil fleet must pay per hull, and the fee grows with the fleet.
